description: Over 100,000 motorists each day pass a stopped school bus. There is no excuse for it, and those who endanger our children need be held accountable.
shortAnswer: There is no excuse for passing a stopped school bus. And there is no reason why bus drivers and school districts should be excused for failing to follow safe crossing procedures. Those who endanger our children need be held accountable.

faq.q: Can children be hurt by their own school bus?
faq.a: Another danger for children is getting run over by their own school bus. When safe crossing practices are not strictly enforced young children get hurt and sometimes killed.
